title: Outbreak Company: Moeru Shinryakusha
titleNative: アウトブレイク・カンパニー 萌える侵略者
synopsis: Having a light novel author father and an eroge illustrator mother, Kanou Shinichi is a thoroughbred otaku. However he does not have any special power except for his broad knowledge, sharp insight, and impeccable instinct about "moe" and its products, from manga to anime to games to light novel to figures. One day he found himself transported to a fantasy world where elves live and dragons fly. And he is given a task—not to fight monster or embark on a quest, but to enhance cultural exchange by becoming a "moe missionary" in this fantasy world! He meets a palace guard who has a bit of fujoshi taste, a half-elf maid, and the empress who is a little girl. He comes up with the idea of building a school. At first it runs as a comedy but later there are serious matters that Shinichi needs to face: ethnic discrimination, social problems, conflict with neighboring countries, sabotage by opposition elements including Japanese government and the likes. Can he overcome the obstacles, successfully bring "moe" culture to the fantasy world, and help the people there as well? (Source: Baka-Manga Updates)

title: Ojousama-kei Teihen Dungeon Haishinsha, Meiwaku-kei wo Bokottara Bazutte Densetsu ni Nattemasu wa!?
titleRomaji: Ojousama-kei Teihen Dungeon Haishinsha, Meiwaku-kei wo Bokottara Bazutte Densetsu ni Nattemasu wa!?
titleNative: お嬢様系底辺ダンジョン配信者、迷惑系をボコったらバズって伝説になってますわ！？
synopsis: The original story is set a few years after dungeons began appearing in the modern world. Karin Yamada is a "dungeon streamer," a new kind of streamer who live streams their expeditions in the dungeon. Though she has adopted the character of a classy rich lady, with zero views and three subscribers, she is decidedly obscure, and depressed about it. One day, she stumbles on an adventurer trying to stir up trouble for views by causing an explosion in a dungeon. Karin immediately leaps into action and stops it by beating up the adventurer. Little did she know that the adventurer was also streaming to a wide audience, who all saw her beating up and lecturing the adventurer. The incident propels her to overnight popularity. (Source: Anime News Network)

title: Golden Phantom
titleNative: ゴールデンファントム
synopsis: Shingo Asahina, who had come to the amusement park with his wife to celebrate his daughter's middle school graduation, spotted a blood-soaked, mysterious man being chased. Instinctively, Shingo covers for him and together they boarded the Ferris wheel. The man began to speak: “In 30 minutes, this amusement park will become hell.” To stop it, he claimed he needed to “borrow” Shingo's body... The unprecedented battle of extraordinary abilities begins—between those who wield the power “Golden Phantom” through objects as their medium!! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Shippo to Gekirin
titleNative: しっぽと逆鱗
synopsis: Aki Miyama is a beastkin who has lived a quiet, unassuming life, blending in seamlessly among humans. Then, one day—quite out of the blue—a beastkin child named Tsukiko suddenly tumbles into his life! Thus begins a shared existence born of a chance encounter between two polar opposites: a socially awkward adult and a guileless, earnest child. Together, they make a home—striving to survive in a world that was never built for the likes of them. (Source: Shogakukan, translated)
